scope: Probe-only architectural consolidation: remove route-specific UI forensics engines and replace them with exactly two universal categories, screenshot-triggered full mounted DOM/native capture and command-armed current-viewport capture.
probe_architecture: Screenshot -> AmazonDark-v7.362-ui-full-probe: every current on-screen WKWebView, entire mounted DOM, full mounted native hierarchy.
scripts/ui-probe.sh arm -> one-shot SIGUSR2 -> AmazonDark-v7.362-ui-viewport-probe: only current screen-intersecting Web/native elements, no scrolling.
Removed Person, Cart, Hamburger/Menu, Alexa/Rufus, Person-submenu, Home-frame and Product-scroll UI probe engines and their route/tab dispatcher.
Removed historical AmazonDark-v7.309 UI-probe filename reuse.
performance_note: Normal runtime retains one screenshot observer and one SIGUSR2 dispatch source; no probe MutationObserver, timer, RAF, Web scroll listener, polling loop, recurring DOM scan or recurring native hierarchy scan.
validation_notes: See AUDIT-v7.362.md for source-preservation proof and regression coverage.
Device testing remains required for live Amazon renderer behavior; local Theos/iOS SDK is unavailable in this environment.
